note: Researched from official funder and university pages; confirm details before applying.

records.name: Chevening Scholarships
records.description: The UK government's global scholarship programme for emerging leaders from eligible countries and territories to complete a one-year master's degree at any UK university. Chevening Scholarships are fully funded. There is no upper age limit.
records.amount_note: Fully funded one-year master's (tuition, living allowance, travel)
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of Chevening-eligible countries and territories
records.deadline_note: The 2027/28 round opened in August 2026 and closed in October 2026 (11:00 UTC; exact date on each country page). The next round is expected to open in August 2027.

records.name: Fulbright Foreign Student Program
records.description: Funds graduate students, young professionals and artists from abroad to study and do research in the United States. Applications go through the Fulbright Commission, Foundation or U.S. Embassy in the applicant's home country, and eligibility and rules vary by country.
records.amount_note: Funding varies by country
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of countries with a Fulbright Commission or participating U.S. Embassy
records.deadline_note: Deadlines are set by each country's Fulbright Commission or U.S. Embassy and vary by country.

records.name: Stipendium Hungaricum Scholarship
records.description: Hungarian government scholarship for students from partner countries to study bachelor's, master's, one-tier master's or doctoral programmes at Hungarian universities. Covers tuition fees, a monthly stipend and a housing contribution. Applicants must be nominated by their country's sending partner.
records.amount_note: Tuition-free study + monthly stipend + accommodation contribution
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of Stipendium Hungaricum partner countries/territories
records.deadline_note: The 2027/28 call has not been published yet. The 2026/27 call closed on 15 January 2026, 2 pm CET.

records.name: NL Scholarship (formerly Holland Scholarship)
records.provider: Dutch Ministry of Education, Culture and Science and Dutch universities
records.description: A one-off grant for non-EEA students starting a full-time bachelor's or master's programme at a participating Dutch higher education institution. Applicants must not already hold a degree from a Dutch institution. It is not a full-tuition scholarship.
records.amount_note: One-off EUR 5,000 in the first year
records.deadline_note: Deadlines are set by each participating institution; 2027-2028 deadlines not yet listed on the national page.

records.name: Eiffel Excellence Scholarship Programme
records.provider: French Ministry for Europe and Foreign Affairs (Campus France)
records.description: French government scholarship that helps French higher education institutions attract top international students to master's (up to age 29) and PhD (up to age 35) programmes. Applications are submitted by the French institution, not by students directly.
records.amount_note: Monthly allowance plus travel, insurance and cultural activities (see programme rules)
records.deadline_note: 2027 campaign dates not yet published on the source page. In the 2026 campaign, Campus France had to receive applications from institutions by 8 January 2026.

records.name: Swiss Government Excellence Scholarships
records.provider: Swiss State Secretariat for Education, Research and Innovation (SERI)
records.description: Research scholarships for postgraduate researchers in any discipline (backed by a supervisor in Switzerland), plus art scholarships for a first master's in an artistic field. Open to applicants from about 180 countries up to age 35. Applications go through Swiss diplomatic representations.
records.amount_note: CHF 2,450 per month
records.eligible_nationalities: Applicants from 183 countries (art scholarships only for some)
records.deadline_note: Applications opened 20 August 2026; deadlines for 2027-28 vary by country of origin and are published per country on the SERI site.

records.name: Swedish Institute Scholarships for Global Professionals
records.description: Scholarships for master's studies in Sweden for citizens of 34 eligible countries who want to drive sustainable development in their home country. Applicants must be liable to pay Swedish tuition fees and be admitted to an eligible master's programme; some nationalities need 3,000 hours of work experience.
records.amount_note: Full tuition + SEK 12,000/month living allowance + one-time SEK 15,000 travel grant (SEK 10,000 for some countries)
records.deadline_note: Apply to programmes via University Admissions 16 Oct 2026 - 15 Jan 2027; SI scholarship portal open 8-24 Feb 2027 (closes 14:59 CET).

records.name: Commonwealth Master's Scholarships
records.provider: Commonwealth Scholarship Commission in the UK (CSC)
records.description: UK government scholarships for candidates from eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries to take a full-time taught master's at a UK university starting September/October 2027. Applicants are nominated by national nominating bodies and commit to return home after the award.
records.amount_note: Full tuition + airfare + stipend of GBP 1,712/month (GBP 2,000/month in London)
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens/refugees permanently resident in eligible low and middle income Commonwealth countries
records.deadline_note: CSC closing date is 16:00 BST on Tuesday 20 October 2026; national nominators may set earlier closing dates.

records.name: Government of Ireland International Education Scholarships (GOI-IES)
records.description: Supports high-calibre students from outside the EU/EEA, Switzerland and the UK to study a master's, postgraduate diploma or PhD (NFQ levels 9 or 10) in Ireland for one year. Applicants need an offer of admission from an eligible Irish institution.
records.amount_note: EUR 10,000 stipend + full tuition fee waiver for one year
records.eligible_nationalities: Domicile outside EU/EEA, Switzerland and UK
records.deadline_note: The 2027 call has not been published yet. The 2026 call closed at 5pm Irish time on 12 March 2026.

records.name: Knight-Hennessy Scholars
records.description: Graduate scholarship at Stanford open to citizens and residents of all countries, with no restrictions on field of study. Scholars receive up to three years of funding for a Stanford graduate degree (JD, MA, MBA, MD, MFA, MS, DMA, PhD and joint degrees) plus the King Global Leadership Program. Applicants must have earned their first degree within the last seven years.
records.amount_note: Up to three years of funding for Stanford graduate study
records.deadline_note: The application for the 2027 cohort is closed. The application for the 2028 cohort opens in June 2027.

records.name: Rhodes Scholarship
records.description: A fully funded postgraduate award for talented people from around the world to study full-time at the University of Oxford. It covers Oxford course fees and an annual stipend, plus application fee, visa and health surcharge, and two economy flights. Applicants apply through their country constituency.
records.amount_note: Oxford course fees + stipend of GBP 20,400 per year (2025-26 rate) + visa, IHS and flights
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of Rhodes constituencies (most countries; check by country)
records.deadline_note: Applications for 2027 entry are closed. Applications reopen in 2027 for entry to Oxford in 2028; dates vary by constituency.

records.name: Gates Cambridge Scholarship
records.description: Full-cost scholarships for outstanding applicants from any country outside the UK to pursue a full-time postgraduate degree (PhD, MLitt or one-year master's) at the University of Cambridge. Covers the University Composition Fee, a maintenance allowance, flights and visa costs, with extra discretionary funding.
records.amount_note: Full fees + maintenance GBP 23,152 for 12 months (2026-27 rate) + academic development and family allowances
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of any country outside the UK
records.deadline_note: International round: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027 depending on the course's funding deadline. US round (US citizens resident in the US) closed 14 October 2026.

records.name: Clarendon Scholarships
records.description: Oxford's flagship graduate scholarship, open to candidates of any nationality in any subject applying for a new master's or DPhil course. Applicants are considered automatically if they apply by the December or January course deadline. Awards cover course fees and a living grant.
records.amount_note: Full course fees + living expenses grant for the period of fee liability
records.deadline_note: No separate application: apply to an eligible Oxford course by its December 2026 or January 2027 deadline (varies by course).

records.name: Lester B. Pearson International Scholarship
records.description: The University of Toronto's most competitive award for international secondary school students starting a first-entry undergraduate programme in September 2027. Students must be nominated by their school. About 37 scholars are named each year.
records.amount_note: Tuition, books, incidental fees and full residence support for four years
records.deadline_note: School nomination deadline was 9 October 2026 and U of T admission application deadline was 16 October 2026; nominated students must complete the scholarship application by 6 November 2026.

records.name: International Major Entrance Scholarship (IMES)
records.description: Merit-based entrance scholarship for exceptional international students entering undergraduate programmes at UBC. Applicants who apply to UBC by the admissions deadline are considered automatically. It is renewable for up to three further years.
records.amount_note: CAD 10,000 - 25,000 per year (2026/27 values), renewable
records.eligible_nationalities: International students studying on a Canadian study permit
records.deadline_note: No separate application; apply to UBC by the admissions deadline for September 2027 entry.

records.name: UBC International Scholars Program
records.description: Need-and-merit-based awards for academically outstanding international students with significant financial need who show leadership and community involvement. Applicants need a school nomination and a teacher reference. It includes four award categories, such as the Donald A. Wehrung International Student Award.
records.amount_note: Award amount based on demonstrated financial need
records.deadline_note: International Scholars Program application due 15 November 2026 for September 2027 entry; documents and English requirement due 31 January 2027.

records.name: ETH Zurich Excellence Scholarship & Opportunity Programme (ESOP)
records.description: Supports outstanding students starting a master's degree at ETH Zurich with a scholarship, mentoring and the ETH Foundation network. It covers full study and living costs for the regular duration of the master's programme. About 60 awards are made for the 2027/28 start.
records.amount_note: CHF 13,500 per semester (from HS27) + tuition fee waiver
records.eligible_nationalities: All (excluding students already enrolled in or holding a master's)
records.deadline_note: Application window 1-30 November 2026 (11:59 CET) for a start in autumn semester 2027.

records.name: Melbourne International Undergraduate Scholarship
records.description: For talented students enrolling in a bachelor degree at the University of Melbourne who are citizens of countries with GDP per capita of US$10,000 or less. Students with an offer for an overseas fee place are considered automatically.
records.amount_note: 20% tuition fee sponsorship for the course duration (from 2027; 225 awards)
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of countries with GDP per capita of US$10,000 or less
records.deadline_note: No separate application; automatic consideration with an offer of an overseas fee place.

records.name: LSE Graduate Support Scheme
records.provider: London School of Economics and Political Science
university_names: London School of Economics and Political Science
records.description: Need-based awards for Home and Overseas students starting diploma and taught master's programmes at LSE. Awards supplement other funding rather than providing a full package. Applicants apply through the Graduate Financial Support form after receiving an offer.
records.amount_note: GBP 5,000 - 20,000 depending on financial need
records.deadline_note: 2027-entry deadline not yet published. For 2026 entry the form deadline was 5pm GMT on 23 April 2026, with an offer needed by that date.

records.name: Aga Khan Foundation International Scholarship Programme (ISP)
records.description: Awards for outstanding students from select developing countries with no other means of financing who are starting a postgraduate programme. The award is 50% grant and 50% loan and covers tuition and living expenses. Applications are handled by AKF contacts in eligible countries.
records.amount_note: Tuition + living expenses; 50% grant / 50% loan
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of select developing countries where AKF ISP operates
records.deadline_note: The 2026-2027 cycle is closed; the next cycle opens in early 2027 (dates not yet published).

records.name: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
records.provider: World Bank Group and Government of Japan
records.description: For mid-career professionals from eligible developing countries with at least three years of development-related work experience who are admitted to one of 44 participating development-related master's programmes outside their home country. Covers tuition, a monthly living stipend, airfare, health insurance and a travel allowance.
records.amount_note: Tuition + monthly living stipend + round-trip airfare + health insurance + travel allowance
records.eligible_nationalities: Nationals of eligible World Bank member developing countries
records.deadline_note: 2027 cycle: Window 1 runs 18 January - 26 February 2027; Window 2 runs 29 March - 21 May 2027 (depends on the participating programme).

records.name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program
records.description: Scholarships for academically talented young people, primarily from Africa, who face financial barriers, delivered through partner universities and NGOs. Support includes tuition, accommodation, books, mentoring, leadership development and a return air ticket. Applicants apply directly to partner institutions.
records.amount_note: Tuition, accommodation, books and materials, return airfare, plus mentoring
records.eligible_nationalities: Mainly young people from Africa (varies by partner)
records.deadline_note: Each partner institution sets its own deadline.

records.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship - Research Students
records.provider: Japanese Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
records.description: Japanese government scholarship for applicants under 35 to study at a Japanese graduate school as research students or in master's or doctoral programmes. Applicants are recommended by a Japanese embassy or by a Japanese university. Tuition is exempted and round-trip airfare is provided.
records.amount_note: JPY 143,000-145,000/month + tuition exemption + round-trip airfare
records.eligible_nationalities: Nationals of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan (check with Japanese embassy)
records.deadline_note: Deadlines are set by each Japanese embassy (embassy recommendation) or university (university recommendation).

records.name: MEXT Japanese Government Scholarship - Undergraduate Students
records.provider: Japanese Ministry of Education, Culture, Sports, Science and Technology (MEXT)
records.description: Japanese government scholarship for applicants under 25 who have completed 12 years of schooling to take a full undergraduate degree in Japan, including one year of Japanese language training. Selection through Japanese embassies includes exams in Japanese, English, mathematics and science.
records.amount_note: JPY 117,000/month + tuition exemption + round-trip airfare
records.eligible_nationalities: Nationals of countries with diplomatic relations with Japan (check with Japanese embassy)
records.deadline_note: Deadlines are set by each Japanese embassy or consulate.

records.name: Harvard College Need-Based Financial Aid
records.description: Harvard meets each admitted undergraduate's full demonstrated need, with the same need-blind admissions and aid policies for international and U.S. applicants. Families with incomes of USD 100,000 and below (typical assets) pay nothing; incomes up to USD 200,000 get at least free tuition.
records.amount_note: Meets 100% of demonstrated need; free for family income under USD 100,000
records.deadline_note: Regular Decision deadline 1 January 2027 (Restrictive Early Action was 1 November 2026). Aid applications have their own deadline but late filing is not penalised.

records.name: Erasmus Mundus Journalism, Media and Globalisation (Mundus Journalism)
records.description: Two-year Erasmus Mundus joint master's in journalism, media and globalisation taught across European partner universities. Around 10-15 Erasmus Mundus scholarships are offered for the 2027-2029 intake, open to all nationalities.
records.amount_note: Full participation costs + EUR 1,400/month for up to 24 months
records.deadline_note: Call for 2027-2029 opens 1 November 2026; application deadline 10 January 2027, 13:00 CET.

records.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Engineering of Data-intensive Intelligent Software Systems (EDISS)
records.description: Two-year Erasmus Mundus joint master's in data-intensive and intelligent software systems. EMJM scholarships waive participation costs (EUR 9,000/year), pay a monthly subsistence contribution and include health insurance; open to all nationalities.
records.amount_note: Participation cost waiver + EUR 1,400/month + health insurance
records.deadline_note: Intake 7 (studies from August 2027): scholarship round 16 Nov 2026 - 12 Jan 2027, 3 pm Helsinki time; later rounds in Feb-Mar and Apr 2027.

records.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Data Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (DEAI)
records.description: Erasmus Mundus joint master's in data engineering and AI coordinated by Université libre de Bruxelles. Erasmus Mundus scholarship holders have participation costs covered and receive a monthly grant for living expenses for up to 24 months.
records.amount_note: Participation costs covered + EUR 1,400/month for up to 24 months
records.deadline_note: 2027 intake deadline not shown on the official fees page; check the programme's admissions pages.

records.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Sustainable Catalysis (SuCat)
records.description: Two-year Erasmus Mundus joint master's in sustainable catalysis across universities in France, Spain, Portugal and Italy. Erasmus Mundus scholarships cover participation costs and pay a living allowance for up to 24 months.
records.amount_note: Participation costs (EUR 18,000 partner / 9,000 programme country) + EUR 1,400/month
records.deadline_note: Application procedure for the 2027-2029 intake opens 23 October 2026; the deadline had not been published on the official page.

records.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Sports Ethics and Integrity (MAiSI)
records.description: Full-time two-year Erasmus Mundus joint master's in sports ethics and integrity, coordinated by KU Leuven. Erasmus Mundus scholarships contribute to travel, visa, installation and subsistence costs.
records.amount_note: Erasmus Mundus scholarship (monthly unit cost) + participation cost coverage
records.deadline_note: Applications open 8 October 2026; Erasmus Mundus scholarship deadline 1 February (2027 intake).

records.name: Europubhealth+ Erasmus Mundus Master in Public Health
records.description: Two-year Erasmus Mundus joint master's in public health across European partner schools. Applicants must apply by the January deadline to be considered for Erasmus Mundus scholarships; the best-ranked candidates are interviewed in February 2027.
records.amount_note: Erasmus Mundus scholarship: participation costs + monthly allowance
records.deadline_note: 2027-2029 intake: scholarship deadline 8 January 2027, 1:00 pm CET; self-funded deadline 24 March 2027.

records.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Radiation and its Effects on MicroElectronics and Photonics Technologies (RADMEP+)
records.description: Erasmus Mundus joint master's on radiation effects in microelectronics and photonics. EMJM scholarships provide up to EUR 1,400 per month for two years, alongside fee waivers and other support.
records.amount_note: Up to EUR 1,400/month for 2 years + participation costs
records.deadline_note: Call for 2027-2029 runs 16 Oct 2026 - 9 Feb 2027 (12:00 UTC) for scholarship consideration.

records.name: International Master in Transfers-Fluids-Materials for Aeronautics Sustainable Applications (TFMASA)
records.description: Erasmus Mundus joint master's in fluids, materials and heat transfer for sustainable aeronautics. One application call covers both EMJM scholarship and self-funded candidates for the 2027-2029 cohort.
records.amount_note: EMJM scholarship: participation costs + monthly allowance (fees otherwise EUR 18,000 non-European / 13,000 European for two years)
records.deadline_note: 2027-2029 call open 1 September 2026 - 1 December 2026, 10:00 CET.

records.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in International Law of Security, Peace and Sustainable Development
records.description: Two-year Erasmus Mundus joint master's in international law of security, peace and sustainable development. The scholarship covers the full 24 months, contributes EUR 1,400 per month to travel, visa, installation and subsistence costs, and exempts holders from tuition fees.
records.amount_note: Tuition exemption + EUR 1,400/month for 24 months
records.deadline_note: Online application opens 4 January 2027; scholarship deadline listed only as February/March 2027.

records.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Sustainable Transportation and Electric Power Systems (STEPS)
records.description: Erasmus Mundus joint master's in sustainable transportation and electric power systems. Scholarship holders receive a monthly allowance for the full programme of up to 24 months, plus participation cost coverage.
records.amount_note: EUR 1,400/month for up to 24 months + participation costs
records.deadline_note: The programme states the application deadline is 15 January of the year studies start (September 2027 intake).

records.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Multilingualism and Cultural Diversity (MultiDiverse)
records.description: Erasmus Mundus joint master's in multilingualism and cultural diversity. Scholarships include a monthly allowance to cover travel, visa, installation and subsistence costs.
records.amount_note: Participation costs + EUR 1,400/month
records.deadline_note: Preliminary application period for the 2027/28 intake: 23 November 2026 - 15 January 2027.

records.name: Master's Programme in Cybersecurity and Assurance (CYBERSURE)
records.description: Erasmus Mundus joint master's in cybersecurity and assurance, open to all nationalities. Erasmus Mundus scholarships cover tuition fees and travel costs and provide a monthly living allowance.
records.amount_note: Tuition + travel + monthly allowance
records.deadline_note: 2027 intake applications open 16 November 2026 and close 4 January 2027, 23:59 GMT+1.

records.name: President's PhD Scholarships
records.description: Highly competitive full PhD scholarships at Imperial College London for high-performing undergraduate or master's students of any nationality. The award covers tuition fees for a 3.5-year PhD, a stipend and a consumables fund. Applicants need a supervisor nomination and apply through their department.
records.amount_note: Full tuition + GBP 27,036/year stipend (2027-28 rate) + GBP 2,000/year consumables
records.deadline_note: Three rounds for 2027-28: 2 November 2026, 11 January 2027 and 1 March 2027 (23:59 UK time). Departments may set earlier internal deadlines.

records.name: Amsterdam Merit Scholarship (Amsterdam Law School)
records.description: Scholarship for outstanding non-EU/EEA students starting an LLM master's programme at the University of Amsterdam's Law School. One award is made per year by lottery among eligible applicants. Other UvA faculties run their own Amsterdam Merit Scholarships with different deadlines.
records.amount_note: Amount for 2027-2028 to be announced
records.deadline_note: Submit with the LLM application by 15 January 2027, 23:59 CET.

records.name: Yenching Scholarship (Yenching Academy, Peking University)
records.description: Fully funded master's in China Studies at Peking University's Yenching Academy, with interdisciplinary humanities and social science courses and residential college life. The Yenching Scholarship covers tuition, accommodation, a living and study allowance, one round-trip travel subsidy and fieldwork costs.
records.amount_note: Tuition + housing + living allowance + round-trip travel + fieldwork costs
records.eligible_nationalities: International applicants (separate track for Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan)
records.deadline_note: 2027 international and Hong Kong/Macau/Taiwan admissions close 30 November 2026, 9:00 a.m. Beijing time.

records.name: Schwarzman Scholars
records.description: A one-year, fully funded Master of Global Affairs at Tsinghua University in Beijing for future leaders aged 18-28 with an undergraduate degree. All fields of study are welcome; strong English is required.
records.amount_note: Fully funded one-year master's
records.eligible_nationalities: All (separate application track for Chinese citizens)
records.deadline_note: The class of 2027-2028 application is closed. The U.S./Global application for the class of 2028-2029 opens April 2027 and runs to September 2027 (exact date not yet published).

records.name: Erasmus Mundus Joint Masters Scholarships
records.description: EU-funded scholarships offered by Erasmus Mundus joint master's consortia to the best-ranked students worldwide. Scholarships cover participation costs and contribute to travel, visa and living costs. Students apply directly to their chosen programme.
records.amount_note: Participation costs + travel, visa and living allowance contributions
records.deadline_note: Each programme sets its own deadline, usually between October and January for courses starting the following academic year.

records.name: Türkiye Scholarships (Türkiye Burslari)
records.description: Government scholarship for international students at bachelor's, master's, PhD and research levels at Turkish universities, with university placement included. Support includes a monthly stipend, accommodation, a one-year Turkish language course, health insurance and flight tickets. Applications are online and free of charge.
records.amount_note: Tuition + monthly stipend + accommodation + Turkish course + health insurance + flight ticket
records.deadline_note: The official calendar lists the general application period as 10 January - 20 February each year; exact 2027 dates not yet announced.

records.name: Global Korea Scholarship for Undergraduate Degrees (GKS-U)
records.description: Korean government scholarship for international students under 25 from NIIED-designated countries to study a bachelor's or associate degree in Korea after one year of Korean language training. Applicants apply via Korean embassies or designated Korean universities.
records.amount_note: Full scholarship incl. 1 year Korean language training + degree study (benefits in the guidelines)
records.deadline_note: 2027 GKS-U guidelines were published on 9 September 2026; deadlines vary by embassy or university track and are listed in the guidelines PDF.

records.name: Global Korea Scholarship for Graduate Degrees (GKS-G)
records.description: Korean government scholarship for international students under 40 from NIIED-designated countries to do a master's (1 year Korean + 2 years) or doctorate (1 year Korean + 3 years) in Korea. Applicants apply through Korean embassies or designated Korean universities.
records.amount_note: Full scholarship incl. 1 year Korean language training + degree study
records.deadline_note: 2027 GKS-G guidelines not yet published.

records.name: Invest Your Talent in Italy (IYT)
records.provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation, ICE Agency and Uni-Italia
records.description: Scholarships for citizens of selected countries to attend English-taught master's and postgraduate courses at Italian universities in engineering, architecture/design and economics/management, with a mandatory internship at an Italian company. Winners are exempt from most university fees.
records.amount_note: EUR 10,800 per year (paid quarterly) + exemption from enrolment fees
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens and residents of 22 listed countries (e.g. India, Indonesia, Brazil, Mexico, Egypt, Ghana, Türkiye)
records.deadline_note: The 2027-2028 call has not been published. The 2026-2027 call ran 20 April - 11 May 2026 (6 pm Italian time).

records.name: Vice-Chancellor's International Scholarships Scheme (VCIS)
records.description: One-off scholarship for high-achieving international students starting a bachelor's or coursework master's degree at the University of Sydney. No application is needed: students with an unconditional offer by a round's closing date are considered automatically.
records.amount_note: Up to AUD 60,000, awarded once in the first year
records.deadline_note: Semester 1, 2027 final round closes 16 November 2026 (unconditional offer needed by then); Semester 2, 2027 rounds close 15 February and 22 March 2027.

records.name: Sydney International Student Award
records.description: Tuition contribution for citizens of eligible countries and regions (including much of Africa, Latin America, South and Southeast Asia) starting a full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework degree in 2027. Applicants submit a short personal statement with their admission application.
records.amount_note: 20% of tuition fees for the duration of the course
records.deadline_note: Apply with the course application; no separate fixed deadline stated.

records.name: RTP and University of Sydney International Stipend Scholarships
records.description: Research scholarships for international students starting a PhD or research master's at the University of Sydney, combining a living stipend with a full tuition fee scholarship. Applicants submit an admission application and a scholarship form by the round deadline.
records.amount_note: AUD 44,293/year stipend (2027 rate) + 100% tuition
records.deadline_note: For Research Periods 3 and 4, 2027 the deadline is 18 December 2026 (the Research Period 1-2, 2027 round closed 11 September 2026).

records.name: ANU Chancellor's International Scholarship
records.description: Tuition scholarship for high-calibre international students starting an eligible undergraduate or postgraduate programme at ANU. All eligible overseas applicants are assessed automatically in nine citizenship-based categories.
records.amount_note: 25% or 50% tuition fee reduction
records.deadline_note: No separate application; automatic consideration with an offer of admission.

records.name: UNSW Scholarships for International Students (incl. International Scientia Coursework Scholarship)
records.description: A single application that considers international students starting full-time undergraduate or postgraduate coursework at UNSW in Term 1 2027 for multiple scholarships. Awards range from partial or full tuition payments to stipends.
records.amount_note: Minimum AUD 5,000; some awards up to full tuition
records.deadline_note: Application round for Term 1 2027 closes 30 October 2026, 11:59 pm AEST.

records.name: Melbourne Graduate Research Scholarships
records.description: Melbourne Research Scholarships and RTP scholarships for high-achieving international and domestic students starting a research master's or PhD at the University of Melbourne. Applicants are considered automatically when they apply for a graduate research course by its closing date.
records.amount_note: 100% fee remission + AUD 41,100/year living allowance (2027 rate) + relocation grant up to AUD 3,000
records.deadline_note: No separate application; deadline is the closing date of the chosen graduate research course.

records.name: Monash International Leadership Scholarship
records.description: Full tuition scholarship for outstanding international students starting an undergraduate degree at a Monash campus in Australia. Four scholarships are available each year and students with an undergraduate offer are considered automatically. Recipients join the Campus Ambassador Program.
records.amount_note: 100% tuition sponsorship for the degree
records.eligible_nationalities: International students (not studying an Australian Year 12)
records.deadline_note: No separate application; automatic consideration with an undergraduate offer.

records.name: Italian Government (MAECI) Scholarships for Foreign Students
records.provider: Italian Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation (MAECI)
records.description: Italian government scholarships for foreign students from eligible countries for second-cycle master's (Laurea Magistrale), AFAM arts programmes, PhD programmes, research projects and Italian language courses in Italy. Awards last nine months and include health insurance; some universities waive tuition for recipients.
records.amount_note: EUR 10,800 total for 9 months (paid in 3 instalments) + health insurance
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of countries listed on the Study in Italy portal
records.deadline_note: The 2027-2028 call has not been published. The 2026-2027 call closed at 14:00 Italian time on 26 March 2026; age limits were 28 (master's), 30 (PhD) and 40 (research).

records.name: University of Glasgow Global Leadership Scholarship
records.description: Tuition fee discount for International and EU fee-status students from eligible countries starting a full-time, one-year taught master's programme in any discipline at the University of Glasgow in September 2027. Applicants need an offer of a place.
records.amount_note: GBP 10,000 tuition fee waiver for one year
records.eligible_nationalities: International/EU fee-status students from listed countries and regions
records.deadline_note: Closing date for 2027/28 not yet confirmed (the university says it is usually in late August).

records.name: Justus & Louise van Effen Excellence Scholarship
records.description: Merit scholarship for excellent international applicants (roughly top 10% of their class) conditionally admitted to a regular two-year MSc at TU Delft. It pays full tuition and a contribution to living costs. Two scholarships are offered per faculty.
records.amount_note: Full tuition + living expenses contribution for 2 years
records.eligible_nationalities: International students (not holders of a Dutch bachelor's degree)
records.deadline_note: Complete MSc application plus scholarship form by 1 December 2026, 23:59 CET.

records.name: EPFL Master Excellence Fellowships
records.description: Fellowships with guaranteed housing for outstanding students starting a master's at EPFL, open to anyone applying to an EPFL master's programme. Selection considers academic excellence plus research, entrepreneurship or civic activities.
records.amount_note: CHF 10,000 per semester for up to 4 semesters + guaranteed housing
records.deadline_note: Master's application must be paid and validated by 15 December 2026 (31 January 2027 for EPFL students applying to a consecutive master's).

records.name: Lund University Global Scholarship
records.description: Merit-based scholarship for top academic students from outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland who are required to pay tuition fees and apply for degree programmes at Lund University. Grants cover part or all of tuition fees, not living costs.
records.amount_note: Part or all of tuition fees (living costs not included)
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of countries outside EU/EEA and Switzerland
records.deadline_note: 2027 scholarship application dates not yet published; the application usually opens in early February.

records.name: Émile Boutmy Scholarship
records.description: Sciences Po's scholarship for the best first-time applicants from outside the European Union whose household does not file taxes in the EU, admitted to the undergraduate College or a two-year master's. It is a tuition fee exemption.
records.amount_note: Bachelor: full exemption or EUR 9,500/year; Master: EUR 18,500/year exemption
records.eligible_nationalities: Non-EU nationals whose household does not file taxes in the EU
records.deadline_note: Master's: 29 November 2026 (2nd committee; 1st was 18 October). Bachelor (foreign secondary schools): 13 January 2027.

records.name: Excellence Master Fellowships (Faculty of Science)
records.description: Fellowships for outstanding, highly motivated students starting a Master of Science in the University of Geneva's Faculty of Science (e.g. physics, chemistry, mathematics, computer science, biology, earth sciences). Renewable for the regular master's duration with academic success.
records.amount_note: CHF 10,000 - 15,000 per year, no teaching duties
records.deadline_note: 2027 deadline not yet published; applications open each January (the 2026 deadline was 28 February 2026).

records.name: Politecnico di Milano Merit-Based International Scholarships
records.description: Merit scholarships for the most talented international candidates admitted to an English-taught Master of Science at Politecnico di Milano. All awards include a full tuition-fee waiver; some add a yearly allowance. Only early-bird admission applicants are eligible.
records.amount_note: Full tuition waiver + allowance up to EUR 10,000/year for some awards
records.deadline_note: Must apply for admission during the early-bird period (application fee paid 1 Oct - 1 Dec 2026); English certificate due by 4 March 2027.

records.name: Reach Oxford Scholarship
records.description: Undergraduate scholarship for students from low-income (OECD DAC) countries who have an offer from Oxford and cannot study for a degree in their own country, for political or financial reasons or because their subject is unavailable. Around 2-3 awards are made each year.
records.amount_note: Course fees + living costs grant + one return airfare per year
records.eligible_nationalities: Nationals of OECD DAC aid-recipient countries
records.deadline_note: Details for 2027 entry will be published in January 2027.

records.name: MIT Need-Based Financial Aid (MIT Scholarship)
records.description: MIT is need-blind and meets 100% of demonstrated financial need for all undergraduates, domestic and international. Aid comes mainly as MIT Scholarship grants, and most MIT students receive need-based aid.
records.amount_note: Meets 100% of demonstrated need
records.deadline_note: Regular Action application due 4 January 2027 (Early Action was 1 November 2026); financial aid application due 15 February 2027 for RA applicants.

records.name: Yale Need-Based Financial Aid (Yale Scholarship)
records.description: Yale admits all applicants need-blind regardless of citizenship and meets 100% of demonstrated financial need. International students get the same need-based aid as domestic students, including housing, meals and twice-yearly travel. Families earning under USD 100,000 with typical assets pay nothing.
records.amount_note: Meets 100% of demonstrated need; zero parent share under USD 100,000 income
records.deadline_note: Regular Decision deadline 2 January 2027 (Single-Choice Early Action was 1 November 2026).

records.name: Bowdoin College Need-Blind Aid for International Students
records.description: Bowdoin is need-blind for international applicants and meets every admitted student's full calculated need. International applicants (excluding Canadians) submit financial aid materials only after being admitted.
records.amount_note: Meets full calculated need
records.deadline_note: Apply through Early Decision or Regular Decision; exact 2027 dates were not shown on the pages checked.

records.name: Hong Kong PhD Fellowship Scheme (HKPFS)
records.provider: Research Grants Council of Hong Kong
records.description: Hong Kong government fellowships for outstanding students worldwide starting a full-time PhD at one of Hong Kong's eight UGC-funded universities. About 400 fellowships are planned for 2027/28. Applicants first file an initial application, then apply to up to two programmes.
records.amount_note: HKD 344,400/year stipend + HKD 14,400/year travel allowance for up to 3 years (2026/27 rates)
records.deadline_note: Initial application by 1 December 2026, 12:00 noon HKT; university applications by 1 December 2026, 11:59 pm HKT.

records.name: Hon Ping Entrance Scholarship for Nigerian Students
records.description: Entrance scholarship for outstanding Nigerian students with financial need to take a full-time undergraduate degree at HKU. It covers full tuition and an annual living allowance for four to six years.
records.amount_note: Full tuition + HKD 305,000/year living allowance
records.deadline_note: Selection on a rolling basis; indicate interest on the HKU application form.

records.name: KAUST Fellowship
records.provider: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology
university_names: King Abdullah University of Science and Technology (KAUST)
records.description: All students admitted to KAUST's graduate programmes (M.S., M.S./Ph.D. and Ph.D.) automatically receive the KAUST Fellowship. It covers full tuition plus accommodation, health insurance and relocation assistance.
records.amount_note: Full tuition + housing + health insurance + relocation assistance
records.deadline_note: No separate application; graduate admission deadlines are set by KAUST Admissions.

records.name: Ministry of Education (MOE) Taiwan Scholarship
records.description: Taiwan government scholarship for international students to take a bachelor's, master's or doctoral degree in Taiwan. It pays tuition up to NTD 40,000 per semester and a monthly stipend. Applications go through the Taiwan representative office in the applicant's country; this listing is the TECRO (United States) version.
records.amount_note: Tuition up to NTD 40,000/semester + NTD 15,000/month (bachelor) or NTD 20,000/month (master/PhD)
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of countries with Taiwan representative offices (TECRO US page: U.S. citizens)
records.deadline_note: 2027 dates not yet published. The 2026 application period was 1 February - 31 March 2026.

records.name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at the University of Edinburgh
records.description: Postgraduate scholarships (on-campus master's or online postgraduate study) at the University of Edinburgh for citizens and residents of African countries, or refugees in Africa, aged 35 or under. Applicants must attend a mandatory information session and are then invited to apply.
records.amount_note: Full scholarship (coverage per programme terms)
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens/residents or refugees of African countries
records.deadline_note: 2027/28 cycle: Applicant Declaration Form closes 26 October 2026, 5pm UK; main application closes 19 November 2026, 5pm UK.

records.name: Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at McGill University
records.description: Graduate scholarships at McGill University for citizens and residents of African countries admissible to an eligible master's programme. Applicants register for an information session to receive the application link; holders of US, Canadian, UK or EU status are not eligible.
records.amount_note: Full scholarship
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens and residents of African countries
records.deadline_note: The Fall 2027 cohort application period is closed; information on the next cycle will be posted in Spring 2027.

records.name: ADB-Japan Scholarship Program (ADB-JSP)
records.provider: Asian Development Bank (funded by the Government of Japan)
records.description: About 130 graduate scholarships a year for citizens of ADB developing member countries to study development-related master's programmes (economics, management, science and technology) at 27 designated institutions in Asia and the Pacific, including 17 in Japan. Applicants apply through the participating institution and must return home after study.
records.amount_note: Full tuition + monthly subsistence allowance (incl. housing) + travel
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of ADB borrowing member countries
records.deadline_note: Each participating institution sets its own intake and deadline; apply at least six months before the planned start.

records.name: Heinrich Böll Foundation Scholarships for International Students
records.description: Scholarships for international graduate and PhD students who completed their previous degree abroad and plan a master's or PhD in Germany, with priority for applicants from DAC countries not yet living in Germany. Good German skills are required.
records.amount_note: Monthly scholarship (amount per foundation guidelines)
records.eligible_nationalities: International applicants; priority for DAC countries
records.deadline_note: Spring 2027 round: portal open 15 January - 1 March 2027; Fall 2027 round: 15 July - 1 September 2027.

records.name: McCall MacBain Scholarships
records.description: Leadership scholarships for a funded master's or second-entry professional undergraduate degree at McGill University. Up to 30 scholars (20 Canadian, 10 international) start each year. Scholars also take part in an interdisciplinary leadership curriculum.
records.amount_note: Full tuition and fees + living stipend of CAD 2,300/month during academic terms
records.deadline_note: Applications for Summer/Fall 2027 are closed; the next cycle's dates are not yet published.

records.name: Banach NAWA Scholarship Programme
records.provider: Polish National Agency for Academic Exchange (NAWA)
records.description: Polish government scholarships for citizens of 36 Polish Aid countries in Eastern Europe, Asia, Africa and Latin America to take full-time second-cycle (master's) studies in Poland. Tuition is waived at public universities and scholars receive a monthly stipend.
records.amount_note: PLN 2,500/month + tuition waiver at public universities + one-time travel support
records.deadline_note: The 2027 call has not been published. The 2026 call closed on 8 May 2026, 3:00 pm CEST.

records.name: Cambridge Trust International Scholarship
records.description: PhD scholarships for applicants from countries other than the UK and Ireland who are highly ranked by their prospective Cambridge department, in any subject. About 60 awards are planned for 2027/28. Applicants are considered through the University's funding application by the course funding deadline.
records.amount_note: International fees + maintenance + student visa and immigration health surcharge costs
records.eligible_nationalities: All countries except UK and Ireland
records.deadline_note: Same as the course funding deadline: 8 December 2026 or 6 January 2027 depending on the course.

records.name: Saïd Foundation Scholarships at King's College London
records.description: Fully funded master's scholarships at King's College London for outstanding individuals from Syria, Jordan, Lebanon and Palestine who are permanently resident there (Syrians living elsewhere may be considered). Up to three scholars are funded each year.
records.amount_note: Full tuition (75% Saïd Foundation, 25% King's) + living costs, arrival allowance, visa/IHS and return flight
records.eligible_nationalities: Syrian, Jordanian, Lebanese or Palestinian nationals
records.deadline_note: 2027/28 application deadline 30 October 2026, 23:59.

records.name: King's Business School Master's Scholarships (Global)
records.description: Scholarships for successful applicants to King's Business School MSc programmes who are nationals of countries outside Europe, with particular welcome for students from the Global South. The school also offers Vice Chancellor Awards covering 50% of fees.
records.amount_note: Up to GBP 10,000 (some awards cover 50%-80% of fees)
records.deadline_note: 2027 deadlines not stated on the page.

records.name: Eric Bleumink Fund Scholarship
records.description: Full scholarships for talented students from least developed countries with no other means of financing to take a one- or two-year master's at the University of Groningen starting in September. Candidates cannot apply directly; they are nominated by the admissions office and faculties.
records.amount_note: Tuition + international travel + subsistence + books + health insurance
records.eligible_nationalities: Nationals of listed least developed countries
records.deadline_note: No separate application; complete the master's application before 1 December 2026 and hold an admission offer before February 2027 to be considered.

records.name: Uppsala University Global Scholarship
records.description: Highly competitive scholarship for fee-paying international students applying to an international master's programme at Uppsala University as their first priority. It covers the full tuition fee but not living expenses; only about 2% of applicants receive one.
records.amount_note: Full tuition fee (no living costs)
records.deadline_note: Scholarship application open 16 January - 1 February 2027 for autumn 2027 start; apply to the programme first via University Admissions.

records.name: Anders Wall Scholarship (Uppsala University)
records.provider: Uppsala University and the Beijer Foundation
records.description: Scholarship covering the full tuition fee for an international bachelor's or master's programme at Uppsala University, currently aimed at students from African nations. Applicants must rank the Uppsala programme as first priority at University Admissions.
records.amount_note: Full tuition fee (no living costs)
records.deadline_note: Uppsala scholarship applications for autumn 2027 open 16 January - 1 February 2027.

records.name: Padua International Excellence Scholarship
records.description: Up to 76 scholarships for outstanding international students entering an English-taught bachelor's, single-cycle or master's programme at the University of Padua. Applying to the degree course is enough to be considered; there is no separate application.
records.amount_note: EUR 8,000 (gross) per year + exemption from student fees
records.eligible_nationalities: Non-Italian applicants with foreign qualifications not resident in Italy
records.deadline_note: First 2027/28 application window for applicants with foreign qualifications closes 15 November 2026.

records.name: University of Twente Scholarship (UTS)
records.description: Scholarship for excellent students (top 5-10% of their class) admitted to a qualifying University of Twente master's programme starting September 2027 who are not eligible for Dutch student finance. Recipients may also receive the additional Kipaji Scholarship.
records.amount_note: EUR 3,000 - 22,000 per year (renewable for year 2 of two-year programmes)
records.eligible_nationalities: Non-Dutch students from listed eligible countries
records.deadline_note: Application deadline 1 April 2027 (separate from course application).

records.name: Choreomundus - Erasmus Mundus Master in Dance Knowledge, Practice and Heritage
records.description: Erasmus Mundus joint master's on dance and movement as practical knowledge and heritage. Admitted applicants receive a tuition fee waiver (valued at EUR 18,000), and 17 scholarship places are available for 2027-2028 with no separate scholarship application.
records.amount_note: Tuition waiver (EUR 18,000) + EUR 1,400/month for 24 months
records.deadline_note: Deadline for scholarships and/or tuition waivers: 15 January 2027, 23:59 EET (applications open 15 October 2026).

records.name: European Master in Migration and Intercultural Relations (EMMIR)
records.description: Two-year Erasmus Mundus master's on migration and intercultural relations with academic mobility across Europe, Africa and Asia. Edition 14 starts September 2027 and applicants can apply for Erasmus Mundus scholarships.
records.amount_note: Erasmus Mundus scholarship (participation costs + monthly allowance)
records.deadline_note: Scholarship and non-fee-paying places: 20 December 2026, 23:59 CET; fee-paying places until 15 July 2027.

records.name: GLOBED - Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Education Policies for Global Development
records.description: Erasmus Mundus joint master's in education policies for global development, with 20 places funded by Erasmus Mundus scholarships per intake through 2029.
records.amount_note: Erasmus Mundus scholarship (participation costs + monthly allowance)
records.deadline_note: 2027-2029 call details will be published in November 2026 (the previous call ran 12 January - 12 February 2026).

records.name: Nanyang Global Scholarship
records.description: NTU's flagship undergraduate scholarship, open to outstanding freshmen of all nationalities. It covers subsidised tuition fees (after the MOE Tuition Grant) plus allowances and Honours College enrolment, with no scholarship bond; international students taking the Tuition Grant have a separate three-year work bond.
records.amount_note: Subsidised tuition + SGD 6,500/year living allowance + up to SGD 2,000/year hostel allowance + SGD 2,000 computer allowance + overseas travel grant
records.deadline_note: Scholarship application period matches the admission application period for the applicant's qualification; exact dates are on NTU's Important Dates page.

records.name: KAIST Scholarship for International Undergraduates
records.provider: KAIST (Korea Advanced Institute of Science and Technology)
records.description: Scholarship for applicants admitted through KAIST's international undergraduate admission. It exempts tuition for eight semesters and pays a monthly living allowance; applicants opt in on the online application.
records.amount_note: Full tuition for 8 semesters + KRW 350,000/month living allowance
records.deadline_note: Considered with the international undergraduate admission application; check KAIST admissions for round deadlines.

records.name: Weizmann Institute of Science Graduate Fellowships
records.provider: Weizmann Institute of Science (Feinberg Graduate School)
records.description: Graduate study at the Weizmann Institute is free and every MSc and PhD student, including international students, receives a fellowship. Students also get help with housing, and teaching is in English.
records.amount_note: Free tuition + PhD fellowship ILS 9,000/month (MSc ILS 7,000/month)
records.deadline_note: MSc deadline is usually around the end of March (see Feinberg Graduate School); PhD applicants arrange with a research group head.

records.name: Czech Government Scholarships for Students from Developing Countries
records.provider: Government of the Czech Republic (Ministry of Education, Youth and Sports)
records.description: Czech government scholarships, offered under foreign development cooperation, for students from selected developing countries to take English-taught master's and PhD programmes at Czech public universities in fields such as agriculture, engineering, computer science, environmental science and economics. Applicants complete an online form and admission tests.
records.amount_note: Full scholarship for selected English-taught master's/PhD programmes
records.eligible_nationalities: Citizens of eligible developing countries (e.g. Cambodia, Zambia, Bangladesh, Nigeria)
records.deadline_note: 2027/2028 applications were open 21 August - 30 September 2026 (now closed).

records.name: Université Paris-Saclay International Master's Scholarship (IDEX)
records.description: Scholarship for international students under 30 enrolling in France for the first time in any non-vocational master's programme at Université Paris-Saclay. M1 laureates are renewed for M2 if they pass all credits. It cannot be combined with Eiffel or Erasmus Mundus scholarships.
records.amount_note: EUR 10,000 per year (paid monthly Sept-June) + up to EUR 900/year travel and visa allowance
records.eligible_nationalities: Foreign nationals enrolling in France for the first time
records.deadline_note: Apply to a Paris-Saclay master's by the programme's international scholarship deadline; 2027 dates vary by programme and were not listed centrally.

records.name: Deutschlandstipendium
records.provider: German Federal Government and private sponsors
records.description: Merit scholarship for high-achieving first-year and continuing students of all nationalities at public and state-recognised universities in Germany. It is awarded regardless of income or nationality; students apply directly to their university.
records.amount_note: EUR 300 per month (half federal, half private sponsor)
records.deadline_note: Each participating university sets its own application period.

records.name: Princeton University Need-Based Financial Aid
records.description: Princeton treats international and U.S. undergraduates the same: admission is need-blind and the full demonstrated need of every admitted international student is met with grants rather than loans. Princeton offers no merit scholarships; all aid is need-based.
records.amount_note: Meets 100% of demonstrated need with grants
records.deadline_note: Aid follows the admission application (single-choice early action 1 November; regular decision date not shown on the page checked).

records.name: Dartmouth College Need-Based Aid for International Students
records.description: Dartmouth's need-blind admissions policy covers all international citizens, and the College meets the demonstrated need of all admitted undergraduates. Aid packages for international students include scholarships and an allowance for travel to the U.S.
records.amount_note: Meets 100% of demonstrated need
records.deadline_note: Apply through Dartmouth's Early Decision or Regular Decision rounds; 2027 dates were not shown on the page checked.

records.name: Arts & Science Global Scholarship
records.provider: University of Toronto (Faculty of Arts & Science)
records.description: Admission award for selected outstanding international students entering the Faculty of Arts & Science at the University of Toronto, based on merit (financial need may be considered). Students are considered automatically.
records.amount_note: Equal to the cost of international tuition
records.deadline_note: No separate application; automatic consideration with the admission application.

records.name: President's Scholars of Excellence Program (PSEP)
records.description: Recognition and award programme for about 150 of the most highly qualified students entering first-year direct-entry undergraduate studies at the University of Toronto. Domestic and international secondary school students are considered automatically.
records.amount_note: Admission scholarship (value set at offer)
records.deadline_note: No separate application; automatic consideration with the admission application.

records.name: York University International Automatic Entrance Scholarships
records.description: International applicants to York University are automatically considered for an entrance scholarship based on their final admission average. The York International Scholarship of Distinction goes to high school applicants with a 90%+ average.
records.amount_note: CAD 2,500 - 37,500 depending on admission average
records.deadline_note: No separate application; the page lists Fall 2026/Winter 2027 values, and 2027-28 values were not yet posted.

records.name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Africa)
records.description: Australian government scholarships for suitably qualified Africans from eligible countries to complete a master's degree at an Australian university. Alumni are expected to return and contribute to their home country's development.
records.amount_note: Full scholarship (entitlements set by DFAT)
records.deadline_note: The 2027 intake is closed. Applications for the 2028 intake open in February 2027 (closing date not yet published).

records.name: Australia Awards Scholarships (Indonesia)
records.description: Australian government scholarships for Indonesians with the potential to contribute to sustainable development to take a master's or PhD at an Australian institution. Includes pre-departure English and academic support plus professional development.
records.amount_note: Full tuition + return airfares + establishment allowance + fortnightly living-expenses contribution + OSHC health cover
records.deadline_note: The 2027-intake round closed 30 April 2026; dates for the 2028 intake are not yet published.

records.name: Chinese Government Scholarship - Chinese University Program
records.description: Full Chinese government scholarship for international master's (age 35 or under) and doctoral (age 40 or under) students, applied for through designated Chinese universities. It covers major study plus any Chinese language or preparatory study. This record uses Northwestern Polytechnical University's official call as the source.
records.amount_note: Tuition waiver + accommodation + monthly stipend + comprehensive medical insurance
records.deadline_note: Applications typically run from early January to early April; each university sets its own deadline (2027 call not yet published).

records.name: Oxford-Weidenfeld and Hoffmann Scholarships and Leadership Programme
records.provider: University of Oxford and the Weidenfeld-Hoffmann Trust
records.description: Fully funded scholarships for outstanding graduates and professionals, mainly from developing and emerging economies, to take an eligible full-time graduate course at Oxford, combined with a year-long leadership programme. Applicants must intend to return to their country of ordinary residence.
records.amount_note: 100% of course fees + living grant of at least GBP 21,805/year
records.eligible_nationalities: Ordinary residents of eligible developing and emerging economies
records.deadline_note: Select the scholarship in the Oxford graduate application and submit by the course's December 2026 or January 2027 deadline; the 2027 process is published by early November 2026.

records.name: Exeter Excellence Scholarships 2027/28
records.description: 150 undergraduate and 150 taught master's scholarships for outstanding international students enrolling at the University of Exeter in 2027/28. Applicants need an offer for an eligible programme before applying.
records.amount_note: GBP 15,000 tuition reduction (each year for undergraduates; first year for master's)
records.deadline_note: Applications open now for September 2027 master's entry and from February 2027 for undergraduates; final deadline not stated.

records.name: University of Nottingham International Postgraduate Masters Scholarship
records.description: Automatic scholarship for international students starting a master's at the University of Nottingham in 2027. It is deducted from tuition fees and no application is needed.
records.amount_note: GBP 3,000 off master's tuition
records.deadline_note: No application needed; awarded automatically on enrolment.

records.name: Developing Solutions Masters Scholarship
records.description: Nottingham's flagship master's scholarship for students from African, South Asian and selected Commonwealth countries who propose development solutions for their home countries. It covers 50% or 100% of full-time master's tuition for one year in eligible faculties.
records.amount_note: 50% or 100% of tuition fees (one year)
records.eligible_nationalities: Domiciled in Africa, India or selected Commonwealth countries
records.deadline_note: The 2026 round has closed; the 2027 round has not been announced yet.

records.name: Mica and Ahmet Ertegun Graduate Scholarship Programme in the Humanities
records.description: Highly competitive graduate scholarships at Oxford for students of any nationality starting a new full-time graduate course in eligible humanities fields (and some area studies and social science courses). Applicants select the scholarship in the graduate application and upload a supporting statement.
records.amount_note: Full course fees + living grant GBP 21,805/year (2026-27 rate)
records.deadline_note: Apply with the Oxford graduate application by the course's December 2026 or January 2027 deadline.

records.name: Oxford-Pershing Square Graduate Scholarships
records.provider: Saïd Business School, University of Oxford
records.description: Up to five full awards covering both a one-year master's and the MBA (1+1 MBA) at Oxford for candidates committed to tackling world-scale social problems. Applicants must apply to both courses and submit a scholarship essay.
records.amount_note: Course fees for master's and MBA + living grant of at least GBP 21,805/year
records.deadline_note: Apply for the 1+1 MBA by 6 January 2027 and the partner master's by its own December or January deadline.
